title: Live registry and the redacted test registry
summary: etc/machines/NODE.machine holds provider=, address=, xtp_link=L3|L4, scope= (the cloud firewall: OCI security list OCID, RESOURCE_GROUP:NSG_NAME on Azure, sg-... on AWS, the VPC network on GCP, a Vultr firewall group id, or none), region=, account=, handle=, project=. It also holds account identifiers (tenancy, projects, instance IDs) and etc/accounts holds gcloud configurations with e-mail addresses, so neither is published. The package carries tests/fixtures/registry: the same nodes, addresses, links and scopes with example IDs; the tests copy it in only when etc/machines is absent, so on the workstation they still run against the live registry. v0.2-dev1 and v0.2-dev2 failed autobuild and were not published; v0.2-dev1 still carried two live identifiers (ed209e's GCP project, ed209k's Vultr instance ID) in its inbox branch.
